title: Bug findings
description: What a bug investigation returns: the root cause with the code that shows it, how to reproduce the bug, and whether an automated test can show it.

root_cause.description: Why the bug happens, in the code, not the symptom.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

reproduce.description: Steps or a command that shows the bug.

testable.description: Whether an automated test in this repo can show the bug.

test_plan.description: Required when testable: which test, where, asserting what.

why_untestable.description: Required when not testable: why no test can show it.
